title: Spawner's And Eggs
description: This Mod Adds Craftable Spawner Blocks And Spawn Eggs, A new ore"Spirit Crystals and a new Sword.
body:
This mod adds:
New Crafting Recipes for all vanilla spawn eggs.
New Crafting Recipe for Spawner Block.
New Ore "Spirit Crystals" found in the nether.
New Sword "Spirit Blade" crafted with Spirit Crystals. 

Spirit Blade does 7.5 damage and makes enemys glow.

Spirit Crystals are used to make Blank Spawn eggs and Blank Boss eggs.

Blank spawn eggs are used for crafting Spawn eggs, And Blank boss eggs are used to craft boss Spawn eggs (wither, Ender Dragon, Guardian, Warden).

To use Spawner just place it and right click it with a Spawn Egg, Be sure it is placed where you want as it does NOT drop.

More to be added soon.
